notes: Default 'New' toggle on the High Stakes page: 10% step 1 target, 5% step 2.
Daily/max loss is 5%/10% on the $2.5K-$25K tabs and 4%/8% on the $50K and $100K tabs; the 50K/100K tiers carry dollar caps computed from those published percentages (4% and 8% of the account size).
Minimum is 3 profitable days per step; a profitable day is closed profit of at least 0.5% of the initial balance, so minTradingDays stores 3 as a floor, not a trading-day count.
Step 1 earns a fixed reward ($2/$5/$10/$15/$25/$40 by tier); the Pro Trader split starts at 80% and scales to 100% with the scaling plan.
News: trades 2 minutes before or after high-impact news are not allowed. Weekend and overnight holding allowed (indices carry a high weekend swap). Leverage 1:100. Platform MT5.
First payout 14 days after receiving a funded account, then every 2 weeks.

Drawdown static: 'The max loss on the account is 10% from your initial balance (absolute drawdown) and 5% daily drawdown that is taken from the closing equity or balance of your previous day (the highest between them)' (faqs/what-is-the-drawdown-rule-for-high-stakes, updated 2026-09-15; the $50K/$100K tabs use 4%/8%).

Refund: the table's 'Refund' is a pass-and-payout fee return, not a cancellation refund: 'Pass Step 1: Get 10% Hub Credit / Pass Step 2: Get 20% Hub Credit / Funded Stage: Get a 70% refund', the 70% being withdrawable 'with your first payout, provided you have generated a minimum profit of $150 and your account has been active for at least 14 days' and only on the externally paid portion (faqs/payout-policy-and-hub-credit-in-the-high-stakes-program, 2026-09-14). The Terms say the fee is 'non-refundable, once you commence said Evaluation trading activity' (full refund only within 5 days with no trading). refundable stays null because the return is partial (70% cash + 30% Hub Credit) and conditional, which the boolean cannot express.

Limited-time Summer Plan (no end date published). Prices are the public list prices on https://the5ers.com/summer-plan/ read 2026-10-20 from a US IP; checkout NOT verified, and nothing is recorded in deals.json.

Homepage banner 'Limited Time Offer! Industry’s Lowest $100K For $149' refers to the 2-Step Summer 10/5 $100K ('Summer 10/5 ($149): Phase 1 profit target is 10%; Phase 2 is 5%.'). The 1-Step $100K is $249.

Daily loss: 'For both the 1-Step and 2-Step summer plans, the daily loss limit is 3%. It is calculated at the end of each trading day based on 3% of your account’s EOD equity OR balance—whichever of the two is higher. When the Daily Loss is reached, the account is permanently terminated.'

Summer allocation: 'The total aggregate buying power allowed across all Summer Plan accounts is $600,000 per trader.' Payout cap $2,000 per cycle on $100K funded accounts, $3,000 on $200K; minimum withdrawal $250.

Copy trading only between the trader's own Summer Plan accounts ('Copying trades from third-party accounts is strictly prohibited', faqs/what-is-the-summer-plan-and-what-are-my-options). News: no orders 2 minutes before until 2 minutes after high-impact news. Leverage 1:100.
Overnight: the Summer page hero says 'Overnight Permitted'. Weekend holding and EAs are not stated on the Summer page; left null.

1-Step table: 'Maximum Loss 6% 6% | Maximum Daily Loss 3% 3% | Target 10% 10% for scaling | Consistency- Per Day 50% 50% | Payout Cap - $2000 | Profit Share - 75%-25% | Bonus - 10% | Refund - Refund From 3rd Payout | Max no. of active accounts 2 | Price $249'. Rules: 'One-time Fee: $249', 'Consistency Requirement: 50% in both evaluation and Pro accounts'.
Drawdown static: 'Maximum Loss: 6% of your initial balance.' Scaling: +25K steps from $100,000 at 75%/25%.

Refund: table 'Refund From 3rd Payout'; the page's refund FAQ describes the 2-Step split (10%/20% Hub Credit, 70% cash with the 3rd payout); for 1-Step it states only '10% of your evaluation fee as hub credit' on passing. refundable stays null.
Conflict: 1-Step table caps active accounts at 2; the page FAQ describes a $600K buying-power cap across all Summer accounts.

payoutFirstDays/payoutFrequency from the firm-wide withdrawals FAQ (14 days after funded activation, then every 2 weeks) and 'Frequency Limit: 1 payout request per 14 calendar days'; the Summer page does not restate them.
